hints.title: Length and Character Filtering
hints.text: Check that the coupon string length lies strictly between eight and twelve alphanumeric characters.

hints.title: Prefix Casing Requirements
hints.text: Verify that the first two characters are uppercase Latin letters.

hints.title: Digit Presence Verification
hints.text: Ensure at least one decimal digit exists anywhere within the coupon token.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: L: length of each coupon string
complexity.notes: Linear character examination for each token against standard validation predicates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regex backtracking on arbitrary patterns can be slow; direct linear checks are instant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output list stores only tokens satisfying all criteria.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check string constraints systematically without redundant passes.
